title: Source photographs for the photo-derived material packs (materials_uhd)
provenance: All files in this directory were supplied by the repository owner: thirteen as chat attachments (stored byte-exact at the size they arrived) and one via Google Drive. Licence, photographer, capture date, camera and native capture resolution are NOT recorded in this repository. They are used only as texture sources; no geolocation is claimed for any individual frame beyond the owner's statement that they were taken in Aokigahara.
resolution_note: The twelve WebP frames arrived at 2000 x 983 px and carry genuine detail at that size. U15 is a phone close-up (HDR-like tone mapping, oversaturated shadows). The true4K file is visibly an upscale of a lower-resolution capture with hard clipped sun dapples and is used only as a fallback source.
